summary: Recent updates in the media control and session management of Firefox focus on improving how audio playback interacts with interruptions. By implementing a system to _track audio-session interruption states_, the browser can seamlessly handle situations where, for instance, a phone call or notification interrupts audio playback. Additionally, new tests ensure that media elements can effectively **suspend and resume** their playback during these interruptions, while also clearing any muted states when playback stops. These enhancements matter because they provide a smoother audio experience for users, making sure they don’t miss out on important audio content, while gracefully handling interruptions.
